BiblicalUsage: Muppim is a son of Benjamin, named among the sons who go down into Egypt with Jacob. The whole house, seventy souls, is carried into the land of their sojourning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Muppim's one line is the promise in seed form: a family goes down into Egypt, and a nation will come up out of it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
